items.text: On Linux a pane can carry a sticky banner, and its busy/idle state is listed.
test/linux/secret-store.sh is executable, like the other Linux acceptance scripts.
A ghoztty:// link from outside the app now focuses its pane on Linux, and the GTK build packages into an installable tarball.
Ghoztty's own agent hook scripts now update themselves when Ghoztty starts, instead of waiting for someone to click Update.
On a see-through window the pane sidebar's backdrop now fades with the grid's, and its card stays solid.
